answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 15908 Country: India Title: My wife always seen a same dream, that some body is doing bad activite and she is crrying. lots time I listen his crrying in the night and I alway hold him in my hands and she always very diffult. Plase tell me what is this Question: My wife always seen a same dream, that some body is doing bad activite and she is crrying. lots time I listen his crrying in the night and I alway hold him in my hands and she always very diffult. Plase tell me what is this Answer ID: 15908 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1647/1357=D=1430) These are satanic effects; she should not pay any attention to the same. If she is awake during the sleep, she should recite: أ للھم إني أعوذبک من شر ھذہ الرؤیا Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
